savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: to terminate the establishing authorities for committees that are inactive or no longer necessary

conclusion: EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, 47 FR 36099-36100) revokes 23 orders by number in secs. 1-23 (each 'is revoked', several 'as amended') and terminates two unnumbered committees in secs. 24-25. It states no effective date (effective on signing), and contains no savings, continuation, transfer or exception provision anywhere in its 25 sections. Sec. 6 (EO 12159), sec. 2 (EO 12042), sec. 3 (EO 12085), sec. 9 (EO 12262), sec. 16 (EO 12089 as amended) and sec. 18 (EO 11256) revoke the batch orders without qualification. Any residual must come from the revoked order itself.
